title: VALUE OS - Embedded Software Engineer
description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.


**Your Role**
-------------


* Design and customize **Secure Bootloaders** for embedded hardware platforms.
* Develop and maintain **Local OTA / OTA/FOTA firmware update solutions**.
* Manage **firmware deployment, validation, release packaging, and software updates**.
* Implement and support **cybersecurity requirements** for connected embedded products.
* Develop embedded software using **C/C\+\+ on RTOS\-based systems**, ensuring reliability and scalability.
**Your Profile**
----------------


* Strong programming expertise in **C/C\+\+** with embedded software development experience.
* Hands\-on experience with **Zephyr RTOS** or comparable embedded operating systems.
* Deep knowledge of **Secure Boot, Bootloader Development, and OTA/FOTA Firmware Updates**.
* Strong understanding of **ARM Cortex\-M architecture** and embedded hardware interaction.
* Experience in **embedded cybersecurity implementation**, including secure firmware and product security requirements.
**What you'll love about working here**
---------------------------------------


* You can shape your career with us. We offer a range of career paths and internal opportunities within Capgemini group. You will also get personalized career guidance from our leaders.

* At Capgemini, you can work on cutting\-edge projects in tech and engineering with industry leaders or create solutions to overcome societal and environmental challenges.
Capgemini is an AI\-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end\-to\-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22\.1 billion.

title: Microsoft Biz Apps – Software Engineer Manager
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**


We are looking for a technically strong and motivated Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations (F\&O) Engineer who brings hands\-on expertise and a willingness to broaden into adjacent Microsoft technologies such as Power Platform and Azure. This role is ideal for professionals with **5\+ years of experience** who are ready to step into a **manager\-level capacity**—driving technical support, mentoring junior team members, and contributing to solution delivery while remaining deeply involved in hands\-on work.


As part of our India\-based delivery team, you will collaborate closely with global teams to deliver high\-quality support and enhancements across enterprise\-scale Dynamics implementations.

**Key Responsibilities**

 **Primary Focus – Dynamics 365 F\&O Development \& Support**

* Provide strong, hands\-on support in troubleshooting and resolving technical issues within D365 F\&O environments.
* Contribute to technical design sessions, code development, peer reviews, and deployment planning.
* Identify, analyze, and resolve system defects and data inconsistencies to ensure system stability.
* Support monitoring of system performance and proactively help maintain optimal system health.

 **Cross\-Functional Technical Contributions**

* Implement minor\-to\-medium complexity enhancements, bug fixes, and integrations.
* Assist in developing and maintaining integrations leveraging **Power Platform**, **Azure Logic Apps**, or related Microsoft cloud services.
* Utilize telemetry, monitoring tools, and analytical insights to troubleshoot performance bottlenecks and improve reliability.

 **Operational Excellence \& Documentation**

* Own incident resolution workflows, ensuring accurate documentation and timely stakeholder updates.
* Contribute to internal knowledge assets such as SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and operational runbooks.
* Support automation initiatives for deployments, environment refreshes, and operational tasks using **DevOps practices**.

**Expectations**

 **Continuous Learning \& Innovation**

* Actively explore new features and capabilities across Dynamics 365 and the Microsoft Cloud ecosystem.
* Participate in knowledge\-sharing sessions, team learning, and cross\-functional collaboration.

**Leadership, Collaboration \& Communication**

* Coordinate effectively with cross\-regional technical and functional teams.
* Communicate confidently with U.S.\-based stakeholders, often during overlapping working hours.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and analysts.
* Explain technical solutions clearly to both technical and non\-technical audience groups.

**Required Skills**  



**Mandatory**

* **8\+ years** hands\-on experience in Dynamics 365 F\&O (AX/F\&O) technical development and support, including X\+\+, LCS, debugging, and data entity integrations.
* Strong experience identifying and resolving performance, functional, and integration issues across the F\&O stack (SQL DB, AOS, services, SSRS reports).
* Solid proficiency in **X\+\+ development**, OOP principles, performance optimization, and scalable design.
* Experience with **source control and CI/CD pipelines** (Git, Azure DevOps).
* Strong analytical skills, structured problem\-solving approach, and strong attention to detail.
* Excellent English communication skills with the ability to interface directly with global stakeholders.
* Ability to operate with moderate supervision and take ownership of assigned tasks.
* The ideal candidate must be flexible and willing to work varying shifts between 2:30 PM and 5:30 AM.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with REST/OData services, Dual\-write integrations, and middleware technologies.
* Exposure to monitoring and telemetry tools such as **LCS monitoring**, **Application Insights**, **Azure Monitor**, and **Power BI**.
* Familiarity with Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) solutions.
* Basic understanding of Azure architecture components relevant to integrations.

 **What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.


In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.


Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.


We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  

  

**How You Can Grow:**  

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  

  

**More about Crowe:**


Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.


Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third\-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre\-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.


We are committed to a merit\-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job\-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: Software Development Developer II
description:
**Join Teleperformance – Where Excellence Meets Opportunity!**


Teleperformance is a leading provider of customer experience management, offering premier omnichannel support to top global companies. Our diverse service locations, including on\-site and work\-at\-home programs, ensure flexibility and broad reach.

**Why Choose Teleperformance?**


We emphasize the importance of our employees, fostering enduring relationships within our teams and communities. Our dedication to employee satisfaction distinguishes us.

Software Development Engineering (High Tech) focus on developing multiple types/categories of software including end\-user applications and operating systems/utility software, that provides a platform for running end user applications for sale to external customers. The work includes:
  

* Conducting requirements gathering and analysis to understand the domain of the software problem and/or functionality, the interfaces between hardware and software, and the overall software characteristics

* Supporting software testing, deployment, maintenance, and evolution activities by correcting programming errors, responding to scope changes, and coding software enhancements

**Be One of Our People:**  

It is our mission to always provide an environment where our employees feel valued, inspired, and supported, so that they can bring their best selves to work every day. We believe that when employees are happy and healthy, they are more productive, creative, and engaged. We are committed to providing a workplace that is conducive to happiness and a healthy work\-life balance. title: Magento Developer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a **Magento Developer** who is passionate about troubleshooting, debugging, and providing technical support for large\-scale e\-commerce systems.  
This is a **hands\-on technical support engineering role** focused on diagnosing, resolving, and preventing complex issues in **Magento/Adobe Commerce** environments.  
If you have strong **Magento development skills** and are open to transitioning into a **technical support\-oriented career path**, this role is for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the **primary technical contact** for Magento application issues, incidents, and performance problems.
* **Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve** issues across the stack — application, web server, and database layers.
* Work extensively with **Linux\-based environments** to analyze logs, processes, and configurations.
* Manage and optimize **Magento hosting environments** involving **Apache/Nginx**, **PHP\-FPM**, **MySQL**, **Redis**, and **Elasticsearch**.
* Handle **networking and infrastructure components** — including **DNS configurations, SSL certificates, CDN integrations, and reverse proxies**.
* Collaborate with developers, DevOps, and cloud teams to reproduce and resolve critical issues.
* Monitor system performance, automate diagnostics, and identify root causes of recurring incidents.
* Document fixes, maintain internal knowledge base articles, and suggest improvements to enhance customer experience.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* **2\+ years of hands\-on experience in Magento (Open Source or Adobe Commerce)** development or implementation.
* Strong command over **PHP, MySQL, HTML/CSS, and JavaScript** within the Magento ecosystem.
* Excellent understanding of **Linux command line**, shell scripting, and server administration.
* Working experience with **Apache or Nginx web servers** — configuring vhosts, SSL, redirects, caching, etc.
* Familiarity with **network\-level concepts** — DNS, CDN, SSL/TLS, load balancing, and firewalls.
* Ability to analyze application logs, web server logs, and error reports.
* Strong debugging mindset with a focus on **root cause analysis**.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills for interacting with clients and internal teams.

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to **Adobe Commerce Cloud**, **AWS**, or **Azure** environments.
* Understanding of **CI/CD pipelines**, **Git**, and **containerization (Docker/Kubernetes)**.
* Familiarity with **performance optimization and security hardening** for Magento.

**Who Should Apply**

* Magento Developers looking to **expand into a technical support or site reliability** path.
* Engineers who enjoy **problem\-solving, system diagnostics, and performance tuning** more than feature development.
* Candidates who take ownership, communicate clearly, and thrive in **high\-impact support environments**.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹800,000\.00 \- ₹1,000,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* What is your current CTC ?
* What is your expected CTC ?
* What is your notice period ?
* Are you willing to work in a Magento Technical Support role ?

Work Location: In person

title: Web Developer
description:
**Web Developer**

**Location:** Hapur, Uttar Pradesh, India  
**Work Arrangement:** On\-site  
**Contract:** Full\-time

**About GCRS Group**

GCRS Group is an international regulatory consultancy supporting brands across cosmetics, fragrance, personal care, food supplements, medical devices and other regulated consumer products.

We are looking for a **Web Developer** to support the development, maintenance and continuous improvement of GCRS websites, landing pages and digital properties.

**The Role**

You will be responsible for creating and maintaining high\-quality websites and web experiences across the GCRS Group.

The role combines technical development, website performance, responsive design, integrations, content implementation and ongoing website optimisation.

You will work closely with marketing, brand, SEO, UI/UX and technology teams to ensure our web presence is professional, fast, secure and effective.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain company websites
* Build responsive and mobile\-friendly web pages
* Create landing pages for marketing campaigns
* Implement designs provided by UI/UX teams
* Maintain website functionality and performance
* Integrate forms, APIs and third\-party services
* Troubleshoot website issues
* Improve website speed and performance
* Maintain website security and technical quality
* Implement SEO\-friendly technical structures
* Manage website updates and changes
* Support content publishing and page creation
* Maintain website backups and documentation where required
* Monitor broken links and technical issues
* Work with the SEO and content team
* Support analytics and tracking implementation
* Ensure cross\-browser compatibility
* Maintain clean and structured code
* Assist with domain, hosting and deployment requirements
* Recommend improvements to the website architecture and user experience

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a practical and detail\-oriented web developer who can take ownership of website development and maintenance.

You should be comfortable working with both technical and non\-technical colleagues and be able to translate business and marketing requirements into effective web solutions.

**Essential Experience and Skills**

* Strong HTML, CSS and JavaScript skills
* Experience with responsive web development
* Knowledge of modern web development practices
* Experience working with CMS platforms such as WordPress or similar
* Understanding of website performance
* Basic understanding of technical SEO
* Experience integrating APIs and web services
* Knowledge of Git
* Strong debugging skills
* Understanding of web security
* Strong communication skills

**Desirable Experience**

* Professional experience with PHP development and server\-side programming.
* WordPress development, including customization, themes and plugins.
* React, Next.js and its application in modern web development projects.
* Hands\-on knowledge of website hosting, server configuration and deployment processes.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager for website tracking and measurement.
* Understanding of technical SEO, including website structure, indexing, performance and crawlability.
* Experience handling website migrations, including content, domains, hosting or platform changes.
* Exposure to developing and maintaining websites for international audiences and markets.

**What Success Will Look Like**

Within your first six months, you will have:

* Improved the performance and reliability of GCRS websites
* Delivered new web pages and landing pages efficiently
* Reduced recurring website issues
* Improved mobile responsiveness
* Supported SEO and marketing objectives
* Established a reliable website maintenance process
* Improved collaboration between technology and marketing teams

**Why Join Us?**

You will have the opportunity to take ownership of the digital web presence of a growing international business.

The role can develop into a senior web development, digital technology or website management position as our digital operations expand.

**Important:** This is a **fully on\-site role based at the GCRS office in Hapur, Uttar Pradesh**. Candidates must be willing to **work from the Hapur office five days a week**.

Work Location: In person

title: Sr. AI Developer Engineer
description:

We are looking for a Senior AI Developer Engineer with strong hands\-on experience in AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and intelligent automation. The ideal candidate should be proficient in Python and experienced in building secure, scalable, production\-grade enterprise AI solutions using modern AI frameworks and cloud platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop enterprise\-grade AI, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions.
* Build LLM applications using RAG, prompt and context engineering, embeddings, semantic search, evaluations, and guardrails.
* Develop AI orchestration workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or comparable technologies.
* Integrate AI solutions with enterprise platforms, REST APIs, databases, identity systems, MCP, and workflow automation.
* Design distributed, cloud\-native, API\-driven, and data\-intensive applications on Azure and/or AWS.
* Implement scalable solutions using Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and infrastructure\-as\-code practices.
* Collaborate with architecture, cloud, security, operations, product, and business teams to deliver reliable and secure AI applications.

**Required Skills**

* 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in AI, ML, Generative AI, or intelligent automation.
* Strong proficiency in **Python**; C\#, Java, TypeScript, or JavaScript is an advantage.
* Strong knowledge of LLMs, Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, semantic search, evaluations, and guardrails.
* Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as **Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, or AWS Bedrock**.
* Hands\-on experience with AI orchestration frameworks such as **Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or CrewAI**.
* Experience with relational, NoSQL, and vector databases, including SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB, and Azure AI Search or comparable vector technologies.
* Strong understanding of Azure and/or AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD, monitoring, and secure software delivery.
* Experience with REST APIs, event\-driven architecture, enterprise identity, tool/function calling, MCP, and workflow automation.
* Proven experience delivering secure, scalable, production\-grade enterprise applications and collaborating with cross\-functional stakeholders.

Pay: ₹400,000\.00 \- ₹1,400,000\.00 per year

* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

title: Shopify/Webflow Developer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a skilled and creative Shopify / Webflow Developer with 1–2 years of hands\-onexperience to join our development team. The ideal candidate should have experience building, customizing, and maintaining responsive e\-commerce and business websites using Shopify and Webflow.

The candidate will work closely with designers, project managers, and other developers to deliver high\-quality, user\-friendly, responsive, and performance\-oriented websites.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, customize, and maintain websites using Shopify and Webflow.
* Customize Shopify themes, templates, sections, and layouts according to project requirements.
* Develop responsive and visually appealing websites using Webflow.
* Convert Figma/PSD designs into responsive Shopify/Webflow websites.
* Work with Shopify Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for theme customization.
* Configure Shopify stores, products, collections, navigation, and basic store settings.
* Integrate third\-party apps, plugins, APIs, and other required tools.
* Troubleshoot and resolve website, layout, functionality, and compatibility issues.
* Optimize websites for speed, responsiveness, SEO, and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Ensure websites are responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to ensure accurate implementation of designs.
* Work with project managers and team members to understand requirements and deliver projects within timelines.
* Perform website testing, debugging, and quality checks before deployment.
* Maintain and update existing Shopify and Webflow websites as required.
* Stay updated with the latest Shopify, Webflow, e\-commerce, and web development trends.

**Required Skills**

* 1–2 years of professional experience in Shopify and/or Webflow development.
* Good hands\-on experience with Shopify theme customization.
* Basic to good knowledge of Shopify.
* Strong understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.
* Hands\-on experience with Webflow CMS and responsive website development.
* Experience converting Figma/PSD designs into functional websites.
* Good understanding of responsive design principles.
* Knowledge of website performance optimization and basic SEO.
* Experience with Shopify apps, integrations, and third\-party tools.
* Good debugging and problem\-solving skills.
* Understanding of cross\-browser and cross\-device compatibility.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
